acceptanceCriteria: Tokens whose components are fragments (<=2 chars, not whole path components) do not produce PATH_LITERAL_READER witnesses
body: internal/unplannedread is selected as a PATH_LITERAL_READER of docs/specs/affected-plan-v0.md by the token `s/a`. Expected: fragments with components of one or two characters do not name repository paths. Evidence: lane gh-affbroad1806 analysis on the PR #1134 range (V1-1806 residual).
title: affected: one- or two-character multi-component fragments (e.g. `s/a`) name paths and select readers
